title: FFmpeg through 9.1 contains an insecure default configuration in the zmq and azmq filters of libavfilter/f_zmq.c that…
description: FFmpeg versions through 9.1 have an insecure default configuration in the zmq and azmq filters that bind an unauthenticated command socket to all network interfaces on TCP port 5555. This allows remote attackers to send commands to change filter runtime parameters and alter processed audio or video streams.
